title: Choose the Squeeze layout
question: Three compositions inside the Ransom Calling Card. The lead card is the one to beat. Lock one; the layout becomes the direction contract.

options.label: The Two-Rail Proof
options.lineage: print shop job ticket beside the press proof
options.thesis: The settings are a paper job ticket on an ink rail; the Batch is the proof sheet; the run bar is the only red field.
options.viewport: Under the red navbar: the Tool name and promise, then a 280px ink rail at left holding 01 Output, 02 Target, 03 Options, 04 Actions on paper forms, and at right the drop zone, the files ledger, and a red run bar carrying the summary, Compress all, Download all, and Clear all.
options.risk: The ink rail can read as the Component Catalog's rail rather than the Tool's own; the numbered groups and the run bar must carry the difference.

options.label: The Press Console Band
options.lineage: press console and numbered job strip
options.thesis: The four numbered groups become one horizontal control band; the fourth cell is the red action cell; the Batch runs under it as a full-width ledger.
options.viewport: Under the navbar and Tool header, a four-cell band across the page: 01 Output, 02 Target, 03 Options, and a red 04 Actions cell holding Compress all. The drop zone and the files ledger fill the width below the band.
options.risk: At 1280 the four cells are tight; at 390 they stack into a tall band and push the files area down. The band must not become a form wall.

options.label: The Bench with Dock
options.lineage: press bench with a run dock
options.thesis: The files are the bench: drop zone and ledger at left, settings on a sticky right column, and a red run dock under the work.
options.viewport: Tool header, then an eight-column files bench at left with the drop zone and ledger, a four-column settings column at right holding 01–04, and a red run dock under the bench with the summary, Compress all, Download all, and Clear all.
options.risk: Settings on the right are the second thing the eye finds; a first-time visitor may drop files before setting a Target and wonder why nothing ran. The empty state must point to the settings.
